items.slide_title: Edit content directly on the page
items.slide_description: With the Visual Editor, editors click any Desiderio element on the page and change it there. They see the result before they save.

slide_image.title: Editing in the Desiderio Visual Editor
slide_image.alternative: The TYPO3 Visual Editor with a Desiderio content element open for inline editing.
slide_image.description: Screenshot of a TYPO3 v14 site with Desiderio.

items.slide_description: This is the seeded demo site on the Lagoon preset. It is a real TYPO3 frontend, ready minutes after composer require.

slide_image.title: Desiderio frontend on the Lagoon preset
slide_image.alternative: The Desiderio demo home page in the light Lagoon theme preset.
slide_image.description: Screenshot of a TYPO3 v14 site with Desiderio.

items.slide_description: Colour tokens give each of the 15 presets a dark mode with checked contrast. This is the pricing page on Midnight, with no overrides.

slide_image.title: Desiderio pricing page in dark Midnight preset
slide_image.alternative: The Desiderio demo pricing page in the dark Midnight theme preset.
slide_image.description: Screenshot of a TYPO3 v14 site with Desiderio.

items.slide_description: Every Desiderio element shows a real preview in the page module. Editors recognise each element at a glance, without grey placeholder boxes.

slide_image.title: Desiderio page module previews
slide_image.alternative: The TYPO3 page module showing Desiderio content elements with their previews.
slide_image.description: Screenshot of a TYPO3 v14 site with Desiderio.

items.slide_title: Ten element groups in the wizard
items.slide_description: The content wizard sorts all 244 elements into ten groups, from Hero and Features to Footers and Conversion.

slide_image.title: Desiderio new content element wizard
slide_image.alternative: The TYPO3 content wizard listing the ten Desiderio element groups.
slide_image.description: Screenshot of a TYPO3 v14 site with Desiderio.

items.slide_title: Restyle the whole site in site settings
items.slide_description: Choose one of 15 theme presets, plus density, radius and fonts, in the site settings. The frontend changes straight away, without a rebuild.

slide_image.title: Desiderio site settings theme category
slide_image.alternative: The Desiderio theme settings in TYPO3, with preset and typography options.
slide_image.description: Screenshot of a TYPO3 v14 site with Desiderio.

items.slide_description: Any part of the page tree can use its own preset, and its subpages inherit it. A campaign can run on Midnight while the main site uses Aurora.

slide_image.title: Desiderio per-page theme preset field
slide_image.alternative: The TYPO3 page properties with the Desiderio theme preset field for one page.
slide_image.description: Screenshot of a TYPO3 v14 site with Desiderio.

items.slide_description: Contact, booking, callback and other forms come as TYPO3 Form Framework definitions. Friendly Captcha and Brevo double opt-in are optional.

slide_image.title: Desiderio forms module
slide_image.alternative: The TYPO3 forms module listing the eight form definitions that come with Desiderio.
slide_image.description: Screenshot of a TYPO3 v14 site with Desiderio.

items.slide_description: Charts, KPIs and tables from the data group, here on the Forest preset. They follow the theme without extra CSS.

slide_image.title: Desiderio dashboards page on the Forest preset
slide_image.alternative: The Desiderio demo dashboards page with charts in the Forest theme preset.
slide_image.description: Screenshot of a TYPO3 v14 site with Desiderio.
